name: Brae
author: Erin Carter
description: A near-black hillside climbs diagonally under a thin moonglow band, its crest a dense fringe of grass-blade silhouettes. Episodic gust fronts ripple along the edge as a traveling seam of rim-light - tips bow into the glow, overshoot, and ring back to dark, leaving the crest a still torn-paper silhouette between gusts.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often a ripple of bowing tips runs the crest.

params.label: Fringe height
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of the grass-blade fringe standing along the crest.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How far the tips bow into the moonglow band and how bright their rim-light gets.

params.label: Moon glow
params.effect: Brightness of the sky band behind the crest, setting the contrast floor of the scene.
